name: Track competitor products and review sentiment on TikTok Shop

parameters.content:
## Track competitor products on TikTok Shop

### How it works

Every morning this searches TikTok Shop for a keyword you care about and upserts every result into a Google Sheet, keyed on the product ID. Because it upserts rather than appends, running it daily builds a live picture of the market instead of a pile of duplicates — price and rating move in place on the row.

It then takes the single top-ranked product and pulls its review insights: the pain points and praise buyers actually wrote, already ranked, posted to Slack so the team reads the verdict without opening the sheet.

### The sheet

No setup needed. Columns are created from the data on first run; `product_id` is the key the upsert matches on.

### Setup

1. Install `n8n-nodes-tiktok-shop-apify` from **Settings → Community nodes**.
2. Add an **Apify API** credential — free account at [apify.com](https://apify.com?fpr=bucho&fp_sid=n8n). On n8n Cloud you can use **OAuth2** instead and skip the token.
3. Connect Google Sheets and Slack.
4. Point the Sheets node at your spreadsheet and pick a Slack channel.
5. Run once by hand, check the sheet, then enable the schedule.

### One search, two jobs

The search output feeds both branches: everything goes to the sheet, and only the top result is analysed, because review analysis costs a request per product.

### Why upsert

Matching on `product_id` means a daily run updates the row it wrote yesterday. You get a current snapshot, and no duplicate rows to clean up.
